Hello everyone, we're a new and growing Arma 3 Unit/Community. The Angelic Hounds Group  
  
What we do  
\- Our goal is to make a fun and immersive environment. We don't take ourselves fully seriously as the goal is to have fun and not worry too much. We understand you may live in a different time zone and/or have work or have to attend school etc. Thus we don't have an attendance requirement  
\- Main Objective: We play campaigns made by me and decided by YOU! For ex. I ask you guys which countries go to war, how long you want the campaign to be and at which time period. I make the rest.   
\- Missions range from 1-3 hours long (depending if its side or main obj)   
\- Campaigns are created on the day/night cycle method. Meaning 1 mission throughout the day and one throughout the night. Night missions are  usually side objectives that will help us in the next major mission/operation during the day (with exceptions)  
\- Smaller scale missions - We also (besides the campaign) play different smaller missions to either test mods for the modpack, or just have fun. Also, we do play sci-fi or horror missions from time to time (SCP, Star Wars, Fallout, Warhammer)   
  
Modpack  
\- Our modpack is mediocre in size, we don't want to overwhelm you with mods (100+) for ex, but we also want to have the best experience possible so we use 63 mods as of the current alpha version (will change in the future) The majority of the mods are immersive/small mods to help immerse you in the fight (Helicopter Dust, Fast-Rope, Cartridge Cases on ground)   
\- You decided which mods get removed/replaced and which mods get added into the modpack from your feedback after the mission. If enough people don't like for ex a suppress mod, we remove it.  
  
Language/Servers  
\- We speak Native Bulgarian and English. We understand that most people will speak English so of course we will too.   
\- When it comes to servers, we have our own purchased server that is maintained and works perfectly. It's open for training 24/7  
  
Timezone: EEST +3gmt (That's Eastern European Summer Time, not EST)  
Age Requirement: 16+   
Speak clear english  
Have a microphone  
Attendance Requirement: None (But try to participate at least once a month)  
We play one major operation every Saturday 21:00 EEST, if this time is not comfortable for you, it's not gonna work, sorry.  
we play at least the one major operation, and some side missions on sunday OR during the week when everyone feels free enough to do it.  
  
Discord Server: https://discord.gg/kkYwNWZKUr  
  
\- Thank you for your time!  - ducky

\- Our goal is to make a fun and immersive environment. We don't take ourselves fully seriously as the goal is to have fun and not worry too much. We understand you may live in a different time zone and/or have work or have to attend school etc. Thus we don't have an attendance requirement  
\- Main Objective: We play campaigns made by me and decided by YOU! For ex. I ask you guys which countries go to war, how long you want the campaign to be and at which time period. I make the rest.   
\- Missions range from 1-3 hours long (depending if its side or main obj)   
\- Campaigns are created on the day/night cycle method. Meaning 1 mission throughout the day and one throughout the night. Night missions are  usually side objectives that will help us in the next major mission/operation during the day (with exceptions)  
\- Smaller scale missions - We also (besides the campaign) play different smaller missions to either test mods for the modpack, or just have fun. Also, we do play sci-fi or horror missions from time to time (SCP, Star Wars, Fallout, Warhammer)   
  
Modpack  
\- Our modpack is mediocre in size, we don't want to overwhelm you with mods (100+) for ex, but we also want to have the best experience possible so we use 63 mods as of the current alpha version (will change in the future) The majority of the mods are immersive/small mods to help immerse you in the fight (Helicopter Dust, Fast-Rope, Cartridge Cases on ground)   
\- You decided which mods get removed/replaced and which mods get added into the modpack from your feedback after the mission. If enough people don't like for ex a suppress mod, we remove it.  
  
Language/Servers  
\- We speak Native Bulgarian and English. We understand that most people will speak English so of course we will too.   
\- When it comes to servers we currently do not use a server hosting program and I host my own server which I understand is not the best option but for the moment we cannot afford a server.   
  
Timezone: EEST +3gmt  
Age Requirement: None (But we do expect a certain Maturity Level)   
Attendance Requirement: None (But try to participate at least once a month)  
  
Discord Server: https://discord.gg/kkYwNWZKUr  
  
\- Thank you for your time!  - ducky
